BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released the notification for the recruitment of Company Commander Posts on the official website of the Bihar Police BPSSC. As per the notification, Online application process for BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Recruitment 2026 has started From 10 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 10 October 2026. There is a total of 65 vacancies has been issued. Candidates must check the details for BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2026
  • Last Date : 10 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
